title: China-to-Iceland Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EEA CE Market Screening and EMC/Radio Scope
rows.target_requirement: For Iceland-facing PV inverters, CE-equivalent conformance screening should cover Directive 2014/35/EU LVD where the voltage scope applies, Directive 2014/30/EU EMC for emissions and immunity, and Directive 2014/53/EU RED where wireless monitoring or communication modules are integrated. Market placement is model-based and route-based by function.
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter evidence often includes GB/T 37408 and grid-code records that can support technical design review. However, GB/T evidence is not a direct substitute for Iceland market-placement scope analysis under EEA-aligned LVD, EMC, or RED.
china_standards: China grid-coupled compliance evidence where available
rows.gap: The gap is often the scope matrix, not only electrical performance. Exporters should map each model to LVD, EMC, and RED applicability, plus marking, DoC wording, importer responsibilities, warnings, and documentation language requirements.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where the model is within EU-directive scopes by EEA alignment; RED only applies where radio communication modules are present
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China GB/T records do not complete EEA CE market-placement scope obligations

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not assume a broad CE outcome from China inverter GB/T files alone. Iceland-facing market placement needs explicit per-model EU-directive scope mapping.

rows.target_requirement: Solar inverters for Iceland should be configured and documented for the local low-voltage profile of 50 Hz with 230 V phase-to-neutral and 400 V phase-to-phase where three-phase is used. Actual protection limits, grid-code settings, and reconnection logic are set by Landsnet and project-level approval requirements.
target_standards: EN 50160 characteristics of electricity supplied by public networks
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter files often target China grid-code profiles (including GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964). Frequency is also 50 Hz, but nominal voltage and protection ranges must be reviewed against Icelandic route requirements.
rows.gap: The practical gap is deployment parameters. Exporters should provide Iceland voltage/frequency windows, protection settings, low-voltage ride-through definitions, anti-islanding thresholds, and commissioning evidence tied to the firmware release used for Iceland operation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where grid interconnection documentation and commissioning evidence is required for project energisation
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China grid defaults cannot replace Iceland interconnection settings

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Frequency is common but parameterization is not. Iceland projects must retain explicit 230/400 V settings and project protection evidence before energisation.

rows.requirement: TS EN 62109 Safety Evidence for PV Inverter Power Converters
rows.target_requirement: Iceland-facing projects commonly reference EN/IEC safety baseline for photovoltaic power converters, typically TS EN 62109-1 and TS EN 62109-2 evidence, while legal consequence depends on the importer, utility, and project compliance route. Coverage is assessed per model and installer scope.
rows.china_equivalent: China documentation may rely on GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964 performance or electrical reports. Those outputs are helpful for technical comparison but do not by themselves prove EN 62109 scope fit for Iceland market placement.
china_standards: Component and test reports where available
rows.gap: Prepare model-specific EN/IEC evidence sets, including thermal derating data, protective-earth and fault-current settings, DC input limits, transformer or isolation evidence, installer instructions, and nameplate labelling aligned to the Iceland delivery model.

mandatory_status.target: Voluntary as a standard unless enforced by project route, utility requirements, or importer compliance policy, but practically expected for many Iceland-facing sales and installation packets
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — GB/T inverter evidence does not automatically satisfy TS EN 62109 target expectation

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T inverter reports alone. Confirm EN/IEC 62109 scope and model-level safety evidence for each Iceland-bound SKU.
